prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 53.0 °C (71% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 59.3 °C (52% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.6 °C (60% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.70 s (5% above healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.76 s (within 1% of healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.29 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 796 W·min/l (108% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 29.9 % (49% below healthy). Slight elevation in power-to-flow ratio reflects incipient volumetric efficiency loss.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 57.3 bar (23% above healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.
